purpose: Quantify patient membership and selected-episode transitions between the locked source-faithful Stage C phenotypes and the post-freeze harmonized diagnosis-date sensitivity, with special attention to why harmonized D0 can exceed the primary lineage-faithful OMOP D0 count.

scope.primary_rule: Preserve the locked source-faithful episode selection, including encounter-date fallback when the selected principal stroke diagnosis has no recorded diagnosis date.
scope.harmonized_rule: Require a recorded diagnosis date before patient-level episode selection, then rerank qualifying episodes using all other locked phenotype rules unchanged.

transition_metrics: same selected source episode among shared patients
different or reselected source episode among shared patients
same index date among shared patients
changed index date among shared patients
harmonized episode later than primary episode
harmonized episode earlier than primary episode
primary selected diagnosis date missing versus recorded
target_transition_metrics: same selected episode among retained patients
different selected episode among retained patients
d0_mechanism_bridge: For patients entering harmonized OMOP D0, determine whether the primary source-selected diagnosis lacked a recorded diagnosis date.
Determine whether harmonization selected a different source episode.
Determine whether the harmonized episode occurred later than the primary source-faithful episode.
interpretation_guardrails: This is a post-result descriptive mechanism audit and does not replace the locked primary Stage C analysis.
The audit quantifies reselection and membership transitions; it does not redefine the phenotype or frozen ETL.
All aggregate transition results will be reported regardless of whether they support the proposed diagnosis-date mechanism.
Patient-level identifiers remain outside Git; committed outputs are aggregate only.
